'''Stormtrooper Empire with Trade-Federation''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stormtrooper (GPN)|Stormtrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-D-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber Sto.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The most of the Charakter are Battle-Droids.

A lot of Starshpis in the Deck
